title: A1 Level Test
description: Comprehensive A1 test covering all modules. You need at least 8 out of 12 correct to pass.

questions.question: Choose the best sentence for this lesson (Verb To Be & Introductions):
options: I am Gabriel. I am from Brazil.
I XXX Gabriel. I am from Brazil.
Brazil. from am I Gabriel. am I
questions.answer: I am Gabriel. I am from Brazil.
questions.explanation: This follows the pattern taught in The Verb To Be — Present Simple.

questions.question: Which word fits the lesson topic "Subject Pronouns"?
questions.explanation: "I" (eu) is key vocabulary for this lesson.

questions.question: Complete using the lesson grammar: ___ afternoon, Ms. Costa.
questions.explanation: Good morning/afternoon/evening + name is friendly and polite. Good night is usually a farewell, not a greeting. Please goes before or after a request:

questions.question: Complete: ___ is your name?
questions.explanation: Use the grammar from this lesson to complete the gap.

questions.question: Which word fits the lesson topic "Possessive Adjectives"?
questions.explanation: "my" (meu/minha) is key vocabulary for this lesson.

questions.question: Complete using the lesson grammar: ___ is an artist.
questions.explanation: Use a/an for singular countable nouns mentioned for the first time or as examples. Use the when the listener knows which one. No article with plural g

questions.question: Complete: The ___ is happy.
questions.explanation: Use the grammar from this lesson to complete the gap.

questions.question: Complete: ___ is a tall building.
questions.explanation: This/these = near the speaker. That/those = farther away. Match number: this/that + singular verb; these/those + plural

questions.question: Complete using the lesson grammar: ___ are many parks here.
questions.explanation: There is + singular noun. There are + plural noun. In questions, invert: Is there a bank near here? Are there any students?

questions.question: Complete: I ___ a bike.
questions.explanation: Use the grammar from this lesson to complete the gap.

questions.question: Complete: ___ there any messages?
questions.explanation: Some in positive statements. Any in questions and negative statements. Some in polite offers and requests.

questions.question: Complete: ___ cat is under the bed.
questions.explanation: Check subject–verb agreement from this lesson.
